summary: The candidate is mathematically correct as stated. The midpoint identity has the correct sign and coefficient, and the fixed-midpoint Cauchy-Schwarz estimate correctly handles repeated midpoints using the injectivity of I -> 2J-I. The common height parity, diameter bound, and finite layer-cake integral establish W <= 2^(N+1) W_* for every N >= 1. The argument includes single-point support, empty parity classes, equal heights, arbitrary affine weights, and boundary points. The supplied accepted predecessor applies directly to the finite atomic planar measure with n=2 and d=0, without any full-dimensionality requirement on the height section. Strict separation places the resulting lattice center in the original complete support, and restricting every original closed halfspace proves the claimed singleton-height depth at least W/64, including the case where the restriction is the whole plane. The asserted width is zero.
